title: Ribbon Finance — Access Control Vulnerability Analysis
root_cause: Insufficient access control on oracle proxy upgrade — anyone could call `transferOwnership` / `setImplementation`
steps: - **2025-12-06**: Aevo deploys oracle upgrade → proxy admin access control unintentionally removed
→ ExpiryPriceUpdated event emitted → System accepts as valid
→ Settlement based on forged expiry prices
→ Settlement amount abnormally inflated by decimal mismatch
